Convert a simplified run_diff summary_table to a gt table

Source: R/run_diff.R
as_gt.run_diff_summary.Rd

Renders the df_footnote and pvalue_legend attributes of the simplified table as source notes, mirroring as_gt.run_correl's footnote pattern. Row-subsetting via `[` (see [.run_diff_summary) preserves these attributes; operations that bypass it (rbind(), dplyr verbs, as.data.frame()) do not, even though class(x) still reads "run_diff_summary" - in that case a generic fallback note is shown instead of nothing.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'run_diff_summary'
as_gt(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A run_diff_summary data frame (i.e. $summary_table from run_diff(..., summary_table = TRUE) with simplify = TRUE).

...

Additional arguments forwarded to gt::gt().

Value

A gt_tbl object.
